تنتقعون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِعُونَ (tantaqiʕūna) /tan.ta.qi.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
# تُنْتَقَعُونَ (tuntaqaʕūna) /tun.ta.qa.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَعَ (intaqaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
